meta.description: Kuchie is a free, open-source iPhone reader for manga and webtoons, with a local library or your own Suwayomi server.
theme.label: Theme
footer.disclaimer: Kuchie does not host or provide any content. You choose what to read and where it comes from.
footer.license: Free and open source under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
hero.title: Manga & webtoons, beautifully on iPhone.
hero.subtitle: Keep your library on your iPhone or connect to your own Suwayomi server. Liquid Glass on iOS 26, free and open source.
soon.title: Coming soon
soon.body: This page is still being written. Until then, everything you need is on GitHub.

home.collections.title: Your library, your way.
home.local.title: Local
home.local.body: Library, history and downloads stay on your iPhone. Import CBZ/ZIP archives and image folders, or add extension stores.
home.server.title: Server
home.server.body: Connect to your own Suwayomi server for your library, download queue, trackers and backups, and save chapters for offline reading.
home.switch: Switch any time. Each collection keeps its own library.
